extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1970s two-door coupe, approx. 5.2 x 1.9 x 1.34 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic 1970s design with long hood, half vinyl roof, opera windows, twin round headlights and wide chrome bumpers; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
